notes.title: Eden Genesis has reached its Kickstarter goal in record time
notes.notes:
Our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/aeternumgamestudios/eden-genesis-a-cyberpunk-adventure]Kickstarter campaign[/url] reached its fund goal in just over 48 hours after the release!

Great news for the whole dev team, and we’d like to thank you all for making it possible in record time. It’s been months of hard work and getting funded in a matter of hours means a lot to us. We were confident about it, and as a token of gratitude, let’s take a look at some of the most important stretch goals we prepared for our lovely community.

The campaign for this cyberpunk platformer hides tons of surprises, including both physical rewards and extra in-game content. You’re about to learn about the first two, one that includes more gameplay options, and the other focused on getting a more immersive experience … Excited enough?

[h2][b]New tier reward[/b][/h2]

It is an expansion of the Level A Ghost (+Physical) tier but adding a digital copy of Eden Genesis for Steam. The new tier is called “Level A Ghost Plus (+Physical)”, and it has been created thanks to the feedback from the community on social media.

Thanks for your constant suggestions and contributions to the project! If you want to access this new reward at an incredible price, visit [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/aeternumgamestudios/eden-genesis-a-cyberpunk-adventure/rewards#reward-UmV3YXJkLVVtVjNZWEprTFRrNE9ESTROek09]this link[/url].

[h2][b]First stretch goal, a replay and practice mode[/b][/h2]

Each trial in Eden Genesis is different from the last, presenting a unique level design and enemy presence. Your ultimate goal is achieving the best score by eliminating all hostile entities, cleaning the SND and keeping your synchro levels at maximum.

Thanks to this stretch goal you can practice adding your own checkpoints to familiarize yourself with the level. The training mode will allow you to perfect your reflexes and marks when you come to a test that seems too complex or in which you do not obtain the expected results.

By being able to add and remove checkpoints at will, you will not need to repeat the entire level. Focus on that section that you are struggling with, and practice as much as you want until you are completely familiar with the enemy layout and platform design.

[h2][b]Second stretch goal, dubbing[/b][/h2]

Eden Genesis is more than a fast-paced platformer, it also features a deep story and in order to make it more immersive, we aim to get full English dubbing for in-game dialogues.

Wish to know more? As soon as the first stretch goal is done, we’ll share more details about it…

Once again, thank you so much for your support. Let’s make the replay and practice mode a reality 😊

notes.title: Play the Eden Genesis free demo!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/39578084/8558c09a208fb17191d9b1dcea52fdabfc3de864.png[/img]

Eden Genesis is a platform game focused on fast-paced trials and quick reflexes in a cyberpunk world dominated by neon lights and corporations. Enjoy the new IP by the creators of the Aeterna Universe!

[b]PLAY THE FREE DEMO[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2562900/Eden_Genesis/

[b]Fast-paced gameplay[/b] - Eden Genesis offers a wide world full of trials that require anticipation, quick reflexes, and nerves of steel. These sections contain both environmental and enemy hazards, besides frantic platforming puzzles. Players must overcome them to cure the illness suffered by the protagonist.

[b]Responsive controls[/b] - The game features an intuitive level design for the players to enjoy precise movement controls. As you become more skilled and Leah liberates more neuron links, Eden Genesis allows you to get even faster completion times every time you enter a trial. In a game with such scale and platforming, responsive controls are a must-have, allowing precise movement and combat.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/39578084/48694e8145f167c86e6cfef9726313c09641e4d7.jpg[/img]
[b]A balanced platformer[/b] - While any player will be able to reach the end of the game and complete the main story and numerous secondary phases, it is true that Eden Genesis offers some extra content for demanding players. Many of the trials are optional, and these offer a level of difficulty that only the most experienced will be able to overcome. However, the main playable and exploration core is designed to be accessible to all players.

[b]Deep story[/b] - Eden Genesis features a stunning plot including philosophic themes and debates about what makes us humans and the limits of science and technology. As every good cyberpunk story does, Eden Genesis makes the player question reality, and have uncertainty about the future.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/39578084/b89abfaa1fc6f1c6322bef381900c632be923885.jpg[/img]
[b]Futuristic setting[/b] - The world of Eden Genesis presents a future in which technological megacorporations dominate every aspect of everyday life. Neon lights and cybernetic implants are the protagonists of a unique 2D artistic design, which gives life to an immersive cyberpunk universe. 

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/39578084/5f236a33adeb4267d9ae1266341e6121353b3127.jpg[/img]

[b]Easy Anti Cheat has been removed[/b]

Aeternum Game Studios has decided to remove the EAC feature from Aeterna Noctis to ensure full accessibility to players and also in response to the demands of the community.

We understand that the addition of this functionality has not been well-received by certain sectors, and has also posed a problem for those players who for accessibility reasons have not been able to enjoy the title.

Instead, we have designed our own anti-cheat system that only applies to the leaderboards of the timed trials. This way, the stats obtained will remain legitimate without affecting the rest of the content of Aeterna Noctis, that is, gameplay elements and features that are single-player.

We have always listened to the community. This has been one of our hallmarks as a dev team. It is thanks to your suggestions that the Aeterna Universe has never stopped including improvements based on player feedback. The message was clear, EAC was an addition that was not liked and now it is history.

We would be very grateful if, just as you have expressed your disagreement with the inclusion of EAC, now that it has been removed from the title, you would also share it on the Steam forum and the rest of the networks, so that the news reaches all players. We trust that this decision will allow Aeterna Noctis to be valued solely for its playable values.

By surprise, Aeternum Game Studios announces that its second title "Summum Aeterna" is available today, a frenetic action Roguelite that you can find available on Steam for a reduced price of [b]€15.99 / $15.99[/b] and launched in [b]Early Access[/b]:


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1815230/Summum_Aeterna/

Summum Aeterna is a [b]Roguelite[/b] that combines a [b]world generation[/b] mechanic never seen before in the genre with a [b]frantic combat system[/b] and an art style Very characteristic unique 2D. At the controls of the King of Darkness, you must explore impregnable territories full of treasures, traps, hordes of enemies, and powerful bosses.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39578084/6b1afa58e2a14e6ea8543cfab12703870a9fe7d5.jpg[/img]

This is a prequel to Aeterna Noctis that introduces us to a [b]King of Darkness[/b] in one of the most convulsive and bloody periods of its history. The rhythm of the combat triples the formula seen in Aeterna Noctis, with frenetic action and a variety of weapons being the main components in the combat system of this new title. The game includes significant improvements and assists over the previous title that will make players feel really agile and powerful in combat.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/39578084/14d8a95d01e5c399cbe946ecd110ef19df50084c.jpg[/img]

Among the features of Summum Aeterna, stands out a world generation system that has never been seen before in a title of the genre. Worlds are created from seeds (or world generators) that, when germinated, create a new challenge with different environmental characteristics, enemy behavior, special rooms and completely random rewards depending on the genes contained in the seed. The so-called [b]Seed Mechanics[/b] will allow players to enjoy a totally different gaming experience every time they venture into a new world.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/42192295/464a562e87ab6da299166ad5fdd878ac3cd75b4a.jpg[/img]


[b]Day One content[/b]

Let's take a look at what is included in the first version of the game currently available on Steam:
[list]
[*] 2 worlds featuring 2 different areas each
[*] 2 final bosses
[*] 1 special room… The Death Roulette! Featuring a mechanic that makes your run even more interesting… Would you spin it? Be careful, it could curse your game or make you unstoppable!
[*] 3 weapon types: swords, scythes, and pistols
[*] 21 unique weapons, each one with different offensive and passive attributes
[*] Introduction to the Seed Mechanic, a unique world generator system: Each seed you find generates a unique world with different enemy behaviour, rewards, special rooms, and map size depending on its genes and rareness.
[*] More than 20 unique world modifiers: The so-called “seed genes” make each seed different from the last, and so will the world generated from them!
[*] Permanent character upgrade system: No matter how many times you’re defeated, your progression in the skill tree will be saved!
[*] Permanent world upgrade system: The world improvements you unlocked will last forever, even if you are defeated a hundred times!
[*] Weapon customization options: Add new attributes and improve the combat performance of your weapons by embedding gems
[*] More than 15 epic music themes
[/list]
Everything mentioned above is already included in the current playable version of Summum Aeterna. We rely on the community feedback to improve the gaming experience. We are willing to include new features based on our player base opinions as well. Feel free to send us your suggestions and share your thoughts!

notes.title: Aeterna Mode vs. Noctis Mode, what is the difference?
notes.notes:
If you are a lover of Metroidvania games, in Aeterna Noctis there is a perfect game mode for you, the Aeterna Mode. However, if extreme challenges and platforming are what you want, you are a Noctis Mode player. But do you know what the differences are between these game modes? We explain it to you.

[b]Aeterna Mode (A pure Metroidvania experience)[/b]
In essence, the game has been completely redesigned to offer you as a player a 100% Metroidvania experience where action and exploration are the protagonists. If it's one of your favorite genres, don't miss the opportunity to get lost in a huge open world with 16 unique areas and hundreds of enemies with unique mechanics. The challenge lies in recovering your power and facing fearsome final bosses that will demand the most of you.

[b]Noctis Mode (Platforms and extreme challenges)[/b]
We could say that for the first time two genres such as Metroidvania and platform games have been mixed. Playing on this mode, you will not only have to explore and recover your powers, but you will also face constant puzzles, platform sections and challenges only recommended for the most demanding players. If you think this is not for you, we do not recommend playing on Noctis Mode since frustration can ruin the experience. This mode includes all the achievements, so it is also ideal for completionist players or for those who, after beating Aeterna mode, want to enjoy the title again with more difficulty.

[b]What if I started in Noctis mode and the difficulty is too much for me? Or... What if I started in Aeterna mode but want a more challenging experience?[/b]
The player can switch between one mode or the other at any time without losing progress and reloading the game at the last save point, allowing the Aeterna Noctis experience to be shaped at your will.

[b]Some examples of Aeterna Mode Vs Noctis Mode[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Ex5bwSa.jpg[/img]

In Aeterna Mode, the spikes have been removed from the platforms to make it easier to fight the enemy. This way you can slide and lean on the platforms without worrying about environmental hazards.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/orEqt2T.jpg[/img]

In Aeterna Mode, the chainsaw puzzle is replaced by an enemy encounter. This way the gaming experience is more focused on exploration and action, moving away from more challenging puzzles.

notes.title: Dev Diary 4 - The lore of Aeterna Noctis
notes.notes:
Hi everybody! It’s Friday at last, the weekend’s almost here! So to celebrate, we bring you a new dev diary with a lot of new details about Aeterna Noctis’ story and lore!

The origin of the conflict between the King of Darkness and the Queen of Light goes back to the times where Aeterna was divided into several kingdoms and other independent states. They all used to have good commercial relationships and live in harmony. But when the soon-to-be King of Darkness took the place of his father as the new duke, everything changed.

One nation after another was conquered by his well trained army, creating a huge empire with lots of territories under its rule. Other kingdoms started doing the same, attacking their neighbours. Only the most powerful remained, and the rest were just annexed to other countries. A decade later, the world of Aeterna was controlled by two main factions: one ruled by the King of Darkness, and the other ruled by the Queen of Light.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39578084/ecdded0a13a06b00a700955a381de662658d0ec3.png[/img]

A cold war started not long after that, and tensions between both contingents began to grow rapidly. This escalation resulted in the inevitable great war that shook the foundations of Aeterna and killed thousands of innocents.

The Supreme God and creator of the universe, Chaos, was so disappointed and enraged with the selfish behavior of the mortal leaders, that he decided to intervene. The divine punishment that he chose was to condemn both of them to fight each other through eternity, thus keeping the balance between good and evil.  To prevent them from ever stopping the fight, He cursed them both with immortality. From that moment, not even death could free them from their punishment.

After that, the cycle of rulers started. Each time one of the two monarchs defeats the other, the winner takes the throne of Aeterna. Once they start their reign, they are allowed to wear a crown: a purple one for the King of Darkness and a silver one for the Queen of Light. As for the loser, the opponent is then reborn, powerless, and must recover their abilities, reach the castle, and start a duel all over again in order to reclaim the throne. 

Apart from the kingdom’s history, we also wanted to tell you about three of the different areas that form the game: the Ascension Cave, the Light Tower, and the Heroes’ Rest.

[h2]The Ascension Cave[/h2]

The Ascension Cave is an underground area where the mining companies used to extract minerals and crystals. The mines were abandoned a long time ago due to a worm infestation, so the area is currently formed by zones full of natural crystal formations mixed with deteriorated mining structures and items.
Nowadays, only the bravest adventurers and some goblins dare to venture into the cave, and they use the old rail system to avoid the worms, golems and other enemies while they travel through the large tunnels. No one would want to run into one of these creatures’ nests or burrows by accident if they wander too far.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39578084/009fca8202c43591c15e91a3b7920b0c55fa63d0.jpg[/img]

The Ascension Cave tunnels are immediately recognisable by its crystalline aesthetics. The crystals are spread out throughout the entire area in different types of formations, from the classic thin and pointed stalactites to crystalline structures with peculiar shapes. You’ll find these formations everywhere throughout the whole area… except for the tunnels dug by Wormolok, the Giant Worm that inhabits the cave. Its powerful maws can destroy every material, including the crystals and the special minerals from the cave, so the areas where it’s past are completely desolated. 

There is also a beautiful specific area that looks exactly the opposite, as it was almost not exploited by the miners and the crystals look almost virgin. It is “The Crystal Forest”, a zone where the crystals grow in tree-like formations of a charming bright green color. 

Other types of areas you’ll find in the Ascension Cave are goblin settlements, ancient handmade structures, and maybe even Wormolok nests if you dig deeply enough into the area. The deeper you go, the stronger the worm presence is. According to explorers’ stories, yellow mountains of worm eggs block the deeper paths, and Wormolok itself might be guarding the path to the old goblin village.

[h2]The Light Tower[/h2]

The Light Tower is the building where the energy to feed the Queen of Light’s soul is guarded. It’s the highest structure in all of Aeterna and it’s made by pure light essence itself. The energy that the queen’s soul uses is extracted from the Cradle of Light, and it’s then transported to the Light Tower in order to store it and generate the lightnings that recharge her soul every 20 seconds. In order to prevent the destruction of the Light Tower, the lighting is surrounded by a mesh that controls the expansion of the energy charge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39578084/4cc4c292c0b0462f9832289f0cda5d5f2fbd4ce2.jpg[/img]

The Light Tower has a vertical design, so you will have to climb, find stairs, and use the several platforms that provide an ascending path. There are also portals that can be used to reach far distances and get away from the celestial guards that inhabit the tower trying to defend the queen’s energy source.

These guards are not the only threat that you will have to face in the Light Tower. The King of Darkness will be exposed to the lightning every 20 seconds, so you will need to find cover. This energy ray cannot harm the tower structure, so its sides will make the perfect place to find shelter.
Even if the area is a vertical tower, there are also multiple secret rooms and side zones to explore. They can be used to rest a bit after running from a ray discharge, find enemies to collect health points from, or simply to explore a bit before facing the boss level.

Visually, the Light Tower is decorated with motifs that point out the balance between light and darkness. All the columns, sculptures and carvings that fill the structure reference the light soul on the top of the tower. Also, the glass windows allow the sunlight to enter the different rooms creating a beautiful and blazing atmosphere. 
 
[h3]The Heroes’ Rest[/h3]

The Heroes’ Rest is a huge graveyard of fallen warriors. It’s one of the largest areas in the game, formed by cemeteries, old cathedrals, ruined churches and underground tunnels. The area aesthetics are especially dark gothic elements like gargoyles, monoliths and statues of fallen heroes of different races, and a horror atmosphere in general, conveying an extremely unsettling and depressing mood.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39578084/e6f3670751d6974bf7ef046a4428873f0b2885ed.jpg[/img]

The inner levels of Heroes’ Rest also have this terrifying aura. The crypts are the darkest type of levels, and they are full of tombs and spiderwebs that look like they’re decorating the rooms. On the contrary, the cathedrals create a chilling atmosphere due to the stained glass windows that let through the minimum amount of light, creating a beautiful image in contrast to the predominantly green colour palette.

Apart from the faint light from these windows, the main source of light of the Heroes’ Rest is fire. The flames are also present in specific areas like the Burning Library, a depressing but majestic zone.
Heroes' Rest is also full of traps. Falling platforms, sharp objects, spear traps… the area is full of the most difficult puzzles which only the most skilled warriors can overcome. Apart from that, various creatures that inhabit the area will stand in your way. The area is filled with the presence of undead warriors, and there are also insect nests if you dig deep enough to the sewers. These are the narrow corridors located under the surface of the Heroes’ Rest, which are dangerously riddled with waterfalls and creatures.

Now that you know some more of the secrets of Aeterna… aren’t you eager to explore it? You will be able too in just a few months, when Aeterna Noctis releases on December 15th!

notes.title: Dev Diary 3 - Meet the Aeterna Noctis team!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We hope you all had a good week :)

In today’s dev diary, we wanted to tell you all about the team of Aeternum Game Studios, the project’s origins, and how we ended up building the game we have right now!

The project started with a team of only five people. We knew each other from work and were passionate about video games, we were good at software development and knew a bit about game design. All these made us start creating Aeterna Noctis as a hobby, even if we did not have a background in game development, but after a while we realized that the project had a lot of potential so we started working on a plan to get investors on board.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39578084/083861e6c80aa82100de0b65b9f37ab379382aab.png[/img]

After one year working on the first alpha version of Aeterna Noctis, we were really happy with how the demo was shaping out. We decided it was time to show it to the world and try to draw some attention to it through a meticulously planned Kickstarter campaign. Despite the campaign not reaching its goal, this worked well, as an investor fell in love with the game and decided to fund the rest of the project!
Once we got the funding, we were well aware that we had to make the most of all our resources, time and people in order to be able to develop the best possible version of Aeterna Noctis. At the same time, though, we really wanted to enjoy this creative experience and make sure that the rest of the team did too. With all this in mind, we applied everything we knew about project organisation, production, and business management, and we also made what we think was one of our best decisions: we hired a Project Manager right at the beginning. 

He was the first person to join the team, and he planned all the schedules, calculated the quality levels we’d be able to aim for, and made sure that deadlines were met and that the development was smooth. This allowed Aeterna Noctis to end up being at least three times superior in quality and performance to what we had imagined at the beginning, thanks to all this planning but also to the excellent team that joined us.

We started the funded development as a team of 15 people, but during the last stages of the project we added six new members to make sure that we could reach the quality and goals that the game needed. Below these lines you can see how our studio looks like nowadays. Everything in Aeterna Noctis has been handcrafted by the studio: design, development, art, music, sound… We believe all of these things give the project and the team work a special value and charm. Besides, some members of the team have been professional gamers for years, so we were able to apply their user experience, knowledge and feedback for our own game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39578084/3b3ad89eda1a26490b16bbf09c5dbc2466d3de20.jpg[/img]

Furthermore, the whole team agreed on which were the premises we wanted to focus on and in which order, to give Aeterna Noctis the perfect game feel. For us, the lore is the most important, as we believe that without a good story there’s no point in trying to communicate feelings and moods through a game, and that it would end up lacking charm and soul. 

The second equally just as important aspect as the story is the gameplay. We developed complex algorithms to give the main character a fluid and unusual movement and feel, apart from the varied abilities and weapons he’ll obtain throughout the adventure.

We have put a lot of love and care into art, music and sound design. Accompanying the story with appealing settings and enemies and having juicy movement and combat is crucial to get a satisfying experience and a good game feel. 

Lastly, we wanted to make sure that there was plenty of gameplay time to enjoy and a lot to discover! Aeterna Noctis is an extensive and detailed game, with more than 20 hours just for its main story and maybe double or triple of that if you want to complete the game to 100%! Happily, there are only a few months left until you can see the final result of all this hard work. Can’t wait to share it with you!

notes.title: Dev Diary 2 - The King of Darkness
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, long time no see!

It has been a while since our last diary update here, but we promise it has been worth it! We have been working really hard on the game and December 15 (our release date, in case you didn’t know) is just around the corner, so to speak. 

As the special date is getting closer and the game is looking more complete everyday, we have decided that we want to show more details about the game’s world and its development, so we are going to make weekly announcements with brand-new game details and images! To start this off, this week we are talking to you about our beloved protagonist, the King of Darkness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39578084/d6472f22a3ab852d271079a2140335e4d0f56bd8.gif[/img]

The King of Darkness is one of the two rival monarchs of the Kingdom of Aeterna, both of them cursed with Immortality by the Supreme God Chaos. Long ago, the conflicts and hatred between the King of Darkness and his nemesis the Queen of Light, escalated so much that it enraged the Supreme God Chaos, so much so that it condemned the both of them to eternal life, intertwined with their never ending conflict as its form of divine punishment. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39578084/3f096bbc35d64836518ac6407365f48bb619caca.gif[/img]

Since then, each time one of the cursed leaders defeats the other, the winner takes the throne of Aeterna, and the opponent must reclaim the throne by recovering their power, reaching the castle, and starting a duel. A cycle starts when one ruler sits on the throne, ending only when either the King of Darkness or the Queen of Light are killed and reborn. Once they start their reign, they are allowed to wear a crown: a purple one for the King of Darkness and a silver one for the Queen of Light.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39578084/017308bc36796eadebaf27de2eb3658f5b392da1.gif[/img]

The King of Darkness is recognizable at first glance. His ashy long hair and pale skin are unique and can not be found in other life forms, human or monster. Despite being hundreds of years old, the King of Darkness looks young, athletic, and has an attractive semble, as a result of having the gift of immortality. No matter how many times he is injured, mutilated or apparently killed, he never shows scars or any kind of damage over the skin. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39578084/502911eaa7baf937e09d8395a5c065cf20424e2c.gif[/img]

Only the emotional trauma is what remains as time continues to pass and the world around him keeps changing. The King of Darkness is the archetypal adventure character. He does not usually show emotions, except sometimes out of anger or rage. He is cold and ironic when he talks to others, and he is scathing in his replies during the dialogues.

The King of Darkness’ visual design has evolved a lot since the first concepts of the game. The first versions showed a being with no face, hands or feet, and an extremely minimalist costume design. As a fun fact, we internally called him “the pijama guy”, and the design ended up inspiring the current logo of our studio.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39578084/fbd12e61d9e09d53d77f1433682215e1347662d0.jpg[/img]

As for his name… What’s the King of Darkness really called? Time has buried his real name, and no one has been brave enough to ask him. Only the elder Chronicler knows it, among many other details of his life, but those are well-hidden secrets that you will have to discover once Aeterna Noctis releases on Steam on December 15th.
